outlets.name: Okinawa Traveler (沖縄トラベラー, by the editors of local magazine Rikka Docca)
outlets.credible: Okinawa-based editorial travel/food site whose features are written by the staff of the local magazine リッカドッカ; area-by-area soba, steak and shokudō features; one editorial source

outlets.name: Good Luck Trip (gltjp.com)
outlets.credible: Japanese inbound-travel publisher with editor-written articles and shop profiles; one corroborating source (directory pages treated as weaker; never paired with another GLTJP page)

outlets.name: macaroni (macaro-ni.jp)
outlets.credible: Major Japanese food media (editor-written features, tens of millions of monthly readers); one source

outlets.name: GIGAZINE
outlets.credible: Long-running Japanese web news outlet with staff-written on-site food reports; one source

outlets.name: Okinawa Prefecture — 「琉球料理が味わえる店」 certification
outlets.credible: Prefectural certification (since FY2023) of restaurants with ≥5 yrs operation, ≥5 Ryukyu dishes and ≥50% local ingredients; official program — counts as ONE source, not a lone authority

outlets.name: Rurubu (るるぶ&more, JTB Publishing)
outlets.credible: Web edition of JTB Publishing's るるぶ — Japan's best-selling travel-guidebook series; editor-written features; one source

outlets.name: Culture Trip
outlets.credible: International travel publisher with named writers (notable travel site); one source

outlets.name: Beer Tengoku (ビール天国)
outlets.credible: Specialist Japanese craft-beer media with brewery profiles; one source for breweries only

outlets.name: Okinawa Convention & Visitors Bureau (Okinawa Film Office)
outlets.credible: Prefecture's official tourism bureau (the body behind Visit Okinawa); one official-tourism source

outlets.name: FUN! JAPAN (JTB)
outlets.credible: JTB-operated inbound travel magazine with editor/writer-bylined features; one source

outlets.name: GAME Watch (Impress Watch)
outlets.credible: Impress Corporation's long-running games-industry news site (staff reporters); one source for game/anime venues

outlets.name: Japan Tourism Agency multilingual commentary database (MLIT)
outlets.credible: National government tourism-agency texts written for site signage; one official source (not a designation)

outlets.name: Japan Experience
outlets.credible: Long-running Japan travel guide/publisher with staff-written destination articles; one corroborating source

outlets.name: All About (allabout.co.jp)
outlets.credible: Major Japanese guide site whose articles are written by named subject 'guides'; one source
